GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out . Recovered & raced Worse than midfield Two Wide (5L from lead) early . Held Ground midrace until 3 Wide @ 450 & pushed along Seven Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 200m & ground home OK in last 150m. # OK for further.
Jumped Ok , enjoyed good trail Two Wide With Cover behind speed 3 Lengths 800m, stayed back inside Leader soon after Straightening Up , Kept Coming late and got very close on line # got close
Slow Out 1 length Settled Down 2nd last 7 Lengths 800m 2nd last 8 Lengths home turn Hooked Out 3 Wide 5th Middle Of Track Kept Going Ok Straight # fair/further
Slow Out 1 Lengths , Settled 3rd last Two Wide 7 Lengths 800m, worked into the race Wide before the corner, Just one paced in Straight , Tongue Tie first time # one paced
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Restrained when tightened for room near the 800m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped OK. Not pushed early & raced Worse than midfield Two Wide (6L from lead). Held Ground midrace & improving 3 Wide @ 500m. Pushed to quicken Seven Wide @ 400m & 9W (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured on outside rail @ 250m & laid in & held ground in last 200m. # Steady effort.
Jumped Fast Eased back 3.5l 1-1 home turn 1.5l 3 Wide Straightening Up Battled on ok without threatening winner # Every Chance

Away evenly. Not pushed early & raced behind Mid Field 3 Wide With Cover (4L from lead). Stayed same until improving Four Wide from 500m & pushed to quicken Seven Wide (1L from lead) on home turn. Pressured @ 250m & faded in last 150m. # Worked & faded.

Began OK. Not pushed early & raced keenly Mid Field Two Wide (4L from lead). Held Ground midrace & pushed out 3 Wide @ 400m. Held together 3 Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 250m & tried to sprint with winner from 200m. Shaded in last 50m. # Tried hard/no match

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped evenly. Niggled early & raced Worse than midfield Two Wide (5L from lead). Stayed same until pushed out Five Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Seven Wide @ 300m & hit top @ 150m. Ran on well in last 100m & just missed. # Ran on well/missed
Jumped Fair eased to last 3-4l off, improved turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off, running on held up passing 100m, kept on final 50m, need to see again # inconclusive

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Settled Mid Field rails 5 Lengths 800m, Saved Ground staying back inside from the cutaway, battled on well last 200m and grabbed minor placing # rail hugging place
